extensionDescription.message: HTTP/HTTPS proxy profiles with authentication and knock hosts.

empty.message: Add a proxy or import MegaProxy / FoxyProxy settings.

knockHint.message: Required in Chromium and when credentials are not saved. Opens at connection and browser startup for proxy authentication.

bypassHint.message: Also applies to subdomains. All other traffic uses the proxy without automatic fallback to a direct connection.

languageHint.message: Auto uses Russian when the browser interface is Russian, and English otherwise.

chromiumCapability.message: Chromium: authentication after 407. Use knock for probe resistance.

firefoxCapability.message: Firefox: immediate authentication through HTTPS proxies; knock is available for HTTP.

knockOpened.message: Knock opened in a tab; the browser will handle 407. Opening the tab does not confirm authentication.

errorHost.message: Enter a host name without a scheme or path

errorProtocol.message: Only HTTP and HTTPS CONNECT are supported

errorCertificate.message: Install a trusted proxy certificate: disabling TLS verification is not supported

errorKnockBypass.message: The knock host must not be bypassed

errorImportRules.message: Transfer FoxyProxy PAC/include/exclude rules manually; import cancelled

errorPrivateBrowsing.message: Firefox: allow the extension in private windows in about:addons — this is required for proxy.settings

errorProxyControl.message: The proxy is controlled by another extension or policy

errorKnockMissing.message: The active profile has no knock host

errorJSON.message: The file is not valid JSON

popupEmpty.message: Add a profile on the settings page.

reorderProfileHint.message: Drag to reorder. Use the up and down arrow keys with a keyboard.

bypassLocalHint.message: Local IP ranges, localhost and local names connect directly. Disable to send them through the proxy.

knockDisabledHint.message: Firefox sends saved credentials immediately. Knock is disabled.

importAbsentHint.message: Existing IDs are updated; omitted passwords are preserved. Select absent local profiles to remove, or leave them unchecked to keep them. Connection settings of active profiles may change.

checkSuccess.message:
Exit IP: $1
Country: $2
Protocol: HTTPS
Load time: $3 ms

errorExportProtocol.message: Current Android supports portable HTTPS profiles with DNS/IPv4 hosts. HTTP or IPv6 proxy profiles cannot be exported compatibly.

errorKnockDisabled.message: Knock is disabled in Firefox with saved credentials

errorCheckBypass.message: Diagnostic hosts must not bypass the proxy

errorCheckHTTP.message: The HTTPS check returned an unsuccessful status

errorCheckNetwork.message: Could not reach the diagnostic site through the proxy

errorCheckIP.message: Could not determine the exit IP

routingAllHint.message: All requests use the selected profile, except local networks and other configured bypass rules.

routingPatternsHint.message: One pattern per line. *.example.com matches subdomains; **.example.com matches the domain and its subdomains. A bare domain in tab mode includes subdomains. Unmatched requests connect directly.

routingTabsHint.message: Proxy requests belonging to tabs whose top-level site matches the list, including resources on other domains. Requests without a tab go directly. Manual tab choices last until the tab closes or routing settings change. Local and profile bypass rules take priority.

routingDomainsHint.message: Only requests to listed domains use the proxy, regardless of the tab. Knock and connection checks still use the proxy; local and profile bypass rules take priority.

noCurrentSite.message: There is no website in this tab. Open a web page to configure its proxy routing.

tabDirect.message: Use direct connection for this tab

errorRoutingPattern.message: Invalid domain pattern: use a hostname and optional * wildcards

errorCurrentSite.message: Open an HTTP or HTTPS site in the active tab

errorSplitUnsupported.message: Split proxy by tab is only supported in Firefox

splitUnsupportedWarning.message: The configuration includes Firefox tab routing settings, which Chromium does not support. These settings will not be imported. If tab routing was active, the manual domain list will be used.

routingDomainsChromiumHint.message: Only requests to listed domains use the proxy, regardless of the tab. Knock and connection checks still use the proxy; local and profile bypass rules take priority. In Chromium selective routing, localhost and link-local addresses always connect directly, even when local bypass is disabled.

listsProxy.message: Update lists through the active proxy

subscriptionsHint.message: Sources are selected independently for each mode. Save settings before updating. Root domains and all their subdomains are combined as **.example.com; covered entries are removed. Up to 1,000 rules: manual rules first, then Tranco popularity. Unknown ranks use alphabetical order. Your browsing history is never sent.

listsNotUpdated.message: No snapshot for the selected sources yet

listsTruncated.message: $1 rules were dropped to fit the $2-rule limit. Dropped domains connect directly unless another rule selects them.

listsUnranked.message: $1 domains have no known popularity rank. Their order is alphabetical; missing rank does not mean unpopular.

errorListSize.message: Downloaded list exceeds the size limit; the last successful snapshot is retained

errorListDownload.message: Could not update lists; the last successful snapshot is retained

errorListEmpty.message: The source has no valid domains; the last successful snapshot is retained

errorListProxyInactive.message: Select a proxy profile before updating lists through the proxy

errorRankingUnavailable.message: Popularity ranking unavailable: using cached ranks where available, otherwise alphabetical order

statisticsHint.message: In-memory counters since counting started. Reset when disabled or the background process restarts. Traffic volume is not measured. Statistics stay locally in your browser and are never sent anywhere.

statisticsPrivacy.message: Enabled by default. Data is never sent anywhere and stays only in browser memory. Disabling clears data and stops collection.

webRTCHint.message: Applies to the whole browser, including direct sites. Restrictions can affect calls. Browser settings releases control back to the browser.

syncHint.message: Uses your browser account. Passwords are synchronized by default; uncheck the password option to exclude them. Active connection, statistics and downloaded lists stay local. Enable browser sync on each device. Last saved configuration wins.

importURLHint.message: Downloads once and opens the same review as file import. Uses the current routing rules. Maximum size: 1 MiB. Prefer HTTPS.

errorPrivacyPermission.message: Grant privacy permission to manage WebRTC.

errorPrivacyControl.message: WebRTC settings are controlled by another extension or policy.

errorWebRTCUnsupported.message: This WebRTC option is only supported in Firefox.

errorSync.message: Settings could not be synchronized. Check browser sync and retry.

errorSyncSize.message: Configuration exceeds the safe sync limit of 45,000 bytes. It remains saved locally.

errorConfigURL.message: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials.

errorConfigDownload.message: Unable to download the configuration or file is too large.

errorRuleURL.message: Use HTTP or HTTPS URLs for the rule test.

networkHint.message: Up to 200 recent requests per tab and 50 tabs. Domains only, without URL paths, query strings or request contents. Navigation or background restart clears the data. System mode cannot identify an external proxy. Selected domains can be added to the manual domain list or Firefox tab-site list.

addCurrentSiteHint.message: Adds the domain and its subdomains to the list and enables selective proxying. Sites outside the rules will connect directly.

siteProxy.message: For this domain: through the proxy

siteDirect.message: For this domain: direct, without a proxy

siteSystem.message: Using the browser’s system proxy settings

siteConnectHint.message: Connect a profile below to add this site to the rules.

errorListCatalog.message: Could not update the list catalog. Using the saved version.

errorListUnknownSource.message: A selected list is missing from the catalog. Keeping the last successful rules.

listsCovered.message: The original “$1” list is already fully covered by “$2”.

networkNoTabs.message: No open HTTP or HTTPS sites

themeHint.message: Auto follows the system theme, falling back to dark when unavailable. If Chrome uses a different theme, choose a theme here.

themeChromiumHint.message: Chromium uses the dark theme by default. You can select the light theme manually.

routingDomainPatternsHint.message: One pattern per line. *.example.com matches subdomains; **.example.com matches the domain and its subdomains; a bare name matches only that domain. Unmatched requests connect directly.
